metadata.label: Note
metadata.value: Full color. Shows geologic units, mineral deposits, mineral springs, falls, fishing stations, buildings, land holders names, schools, parish and county boundaries, notes, etc. Relief shown by spot heights. The maps index the various geological reports. Rumsey collection maps backed on linen; protected in new blue cloth folding boards with blue cloth slip case 22 x 16.5 cm., stamped with title "Cape Breton, Nova Scotia, Geological Survey of Canada, 1884" on spine in gold.

metadata.label: Pub Note
metadata.value: 24 separate sheets backed on linen showing the geology of Cape Breton Island, as well as very detailed cultural information, including the placement of houses, schools, churches, farms, roads, etc. They were issued to accompany reports by Hugh Fletcher from 1879-1884. Printed in full color. Rumsey Collection copy: maps are protected in new blue cloth folding boards with blue cloth slip case 22x16.5 stamped with the title "Cape Breton, Nova Scotia. Geological Survey Of Canada. 1884" on the spine in gold.
